error_codes.name: Compass Error
error_codes.description: Compass calibration failed or sensor error detected
resolution_steps: Move drone away from magnetic interference sources
Perform manual compass calibration
Restart the drone
Contact support if issue persists

error_codes.name: Compass Interference
error_codes.description: Magnetic field interference detected near drone
resolution_steps: Move to a location away from power lines and metal structures
Wait 30 seconds for magnetic field to stabilize
Retry compass calibration

error_codes.name: IMU Error
resolution_steps: Ensure drone is on a level surface
Perform IMU calibration using DJI Fly app
Restart drone
Contact support if persists

error_codes.name: GPS Signal Weak
error_codes.description: Insufficient GPS satellite signal for stable positioning
resolution_steps: Move to an open area with clear sky view
Wait 30-60 seconds for GPS acquisition
Check if antenna is obstructed
Avoid flying near tall buildings or dense tree cover

error_codes.name: Return-To-Home Failed
error_codes.description: RTH function failed due to GPS or compass issues
resolution_steps: Switch to manual control immediately
Verify GPS signal strength
Land manually and recalibrate compass
Set a new home point after landing

error_codes.name: Battery Low Warning
error_codes.description: Battery level dropped below safe threshold for return flight
resolution_steps: Return to home immediately
Reduce altitude to minimize power consumption
Land as soon as safely possible
Replace or charge battery before next flight

error_codes.name: Battery Critical
error_codes.description: Battery at critical level — forced landing imminent
resolution_steps: Drone will auto-land — clear landing area below
Cannot cancel forced landing at this level
After landing, inspect battery health in DJI Fly app
Replace battery if degraded

error_codes.name: Gimbal Overload
error_codes.description: Gimbal motor is overloaded or obstructed
resolution_steps: Power off the drone
Remove any obstructions from the gimbal
Remove gimbal protector if still attached
Restart and run gimbal auto-calibration

error_codes.name: Gimbal Calibration Error
error_codes.description: Gimbal calibration failed — sensor misalignment detected
resolution_steps: Place drone on flat, stable surface
Run gimbal calibration from DJI Fly app settings
Ensure no external vibration during calibration
Contact DJI support if calibration fails repeatedly

error_codes.name: Motor Blocked
error_codes.description: One or more motors are blocked or stalled
resolution_steps: DO NOT attempt to fly
Inspect propellers for debris or damage
Check that propellers are correctly mounted
Spin each motor gently by hand to check for resistance
Replace damaged propellers or contact support

error_codes.name: Obstacle Avoidance Sensor Error
error_codes.description: Vision or infrared obstacle avoidance sensor malfunction
resolution_steps: Clean sensor lenses with a soft cloth
Ensure sensors are not covered or fogged
Restart the drone
If persists, fly with obstacle avoidance disabled (use caution)

error_codes.name: SD Card Error
error_codes.description: MicroSD card not detected or write error
resolution_steps: Remove and reinsert the microSD card
Format the card using DJI Fly app
Try a different compatible microSD card (U3/V30 recommended)
Check card for physical damage
